summary:
Thin bank/strategist coverage this window — 8 kept items across 4 banks out of 60 tweets scanned; the rest was MikeZaccardi's untagged intraday price/chart commentary, dropped as noise per the routine's filter. Goldman led with 4 items: prime-brokerage data showed the second-largest monthly gross-leverage decline on record, physical oil markets are tightening (visible stocks drawing 6.3mb/d) even as WTI trades sub-$75, plus box-office and Dow-mover notes. Citadel contributed 2 items — July fund performance (+5.9%) and Scott Rubner's note that corporate demand is set to reaccelerate as positioning turns cleaner. JPMorgan flagged the retail inventory/sales ratio at its lowest since before the last three recessions; SocGen (Kabra) flagged margin expansion broadening to 10 of 11 sectors. No Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) activity appeared in this window.

By bank: Goldman 4, Citadel 2, JPM 1, SocGen 1.
